messages:
maria (eng-platform): Heads up — we're consolidating regional dashboards. Need runtime + infra inputs for latency-by-region, cross-region failover impact, and traffic-split metrics. Can runtime/infra owners chime in? (want to ship by EOW)

sam (eng-runtime): On it. What latency buckets do you want? p50/p95/p99/p999? Also need per-model and per-route tags.

yuki (eng-infra): We'll need consistent label set: region, zone, model, route, tier. Avoid high-cardinality labels (user_id). We'll add sampling if needed.

noah (eng-sre): Concern: enabling p999 per-route per-model will blow Prom ingestion. Can we approximate via histograms + summaries? Consider using hdrhistogram on the agent side.

maria (eng-platform): Good call. For initial pass: p50/p95/p99 + p999 at region-level only. Per-route per-model: p50/p95/p99. Also want failover counts and latency delta when failover happens.

sam (eng-runtime): We'll emit these metrics:
- redwood.rpc.latency_ms_hist (labels: region, model, route)
- redwood.rpc.failover_count (labels: from_region, to_region, reason)
- redwood.rpc.traffic_split (labels: region, route, variant) with sample rate 1s

sam (eng-runtime): Example PromQL to get regional p99:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_rpc_latency_ms_hist_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))
```

yuki (eng-infra): We'll add region dashboards and a cross-region panel showing failovers over time + a panel for latency delta during failover windows. Also add a note about retention/cost.

prasad (product): UI asks: can we show traffic-split slider & time comparison (pre/post rollout) in Console? Also need annotations when failover/rollouts occurred.

maria (eng-platform): Yes — platform can surface annotations from rollout service. @noah please confirm annotation format.

noah (eng-sre): We'll push events to /annotations with {ts, type, meta} — consumeable by Grafana and Console. Example: {ts: 1769990000, type: "failover", meta: "to:eu-west-1"}

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-7214 - "Regional latency dashboard + failover panels" (assignee: sam)

sam (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR for metric names + export code this afternoon. I'll tag infra + platform for review.

maria (eng-platform): Thanks — next sync Thurs 11am. I'll draft dashboard layout and share link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/regional-latency

prasad (product): +1. If we can get a simple traffic-split chart and rollout annotation, that's 80% of product needs.

yuki (eng-infra): FYI we'll enable 7d retention for these metrics initially, may drop to 3d after rollout to control cost.

maria (eng-platform): Great. I'll update the ticket with acceptance criteria: p99 by region, failover timeline panel, traffic split time-series, annotations, and Console embedding.

noah (eng-sre): One more: add an alert rule if regional p99 increases > 3x baseline for 10m.

maria (eng-platform): Noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
